entries.content_plain:
Introduction

 Hiram sends artificers and materials to David, to build him a house, 1Chr 14:1 , 1Chr 14:2 . David's wives and children, 1Chr 14:3-7 . He defeats the Philistines in two battles: one in the valley of Rephaim, 1Chr 14:8-12 ; and the other at Gibeon and Gazer, 1Chr 14:13-16 . His fame goes out into all the surrounding nations, 1Chr 14:17 . 

 Verse 1 

 Now Hiram king of Tyre - See the transactions of this chapter related 2Sam 5:11-25 (note).
